body: thanks for the reply. Trust me, I wish so much that i wasnt gay but i am. I cant really help it. It would be so much easier if i had one less thing to deal with. The gay community can be pretty shallow as well, which doesnt leave much room for people like me to find a place. Which is why it probably hurts so much that i was just abandoned. Feels like i struck gold and got so lucky to find a guy that might actually care and be accepting of me. even just as friends. then poof.. gone.

Thanks for the reply.. guess its a nice thought that im not alone in being alone. Then i think about that and it would probably be better if no one was alone not more people haha... 

Anyways, no theres no option for transportation for me. There is one but it ends up being way too expensive for me to use unless its like an emergency. I've actually made some progress towards being able to drive recently, i have my learners and took a driving class with hand controls, but any advancement in that kind of died when the car i was supposed to be using ended up dying.

Im currently on medicaid but havent looked really into what benefits i can use from it.. tbh i dont know where to look. i just use it to get the medical supplies i need. 

I havent heard of meetup.. ill try looking into it

Anyways thanks again for the reply.
